description: This file contains unit tests for the GlobalCommandRegistry class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.base package. It tests registration of command types, parsing of command JSON objects, and exception handling.

classes.name: GlobalCommandRegistryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the GlobalCommandRegistry's functionality, including command type recognition, JSON parsing, immutability, and exception handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up the GlobalCommandRegistry instance and a default DittoHeaders object.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests whether the GlobalCommandRegistry class is immutable.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryKnowsJsonTypeTestCommand
methods.description: Verifies that the registry recognizes the test command type.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryParsesTestJsonObject
methods.description: Checks whether a JSON object with a specific type is correctly parsed into a TestCommand instance.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryWrapsExceptionInDittoJsonException
methods.description: Ensures that parsing an invalid JSON object throws a DittoJsonException.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryThrowsJsonTypeNotParsableException
methods.description: Tests that an unrecognized command type in JSON leads to a JsonTypeNotParsableException.
